integrity: The proof starts from the source's exact harmonic Schwarzian formula. A reverse-triangle inequality gives the sharp circlewise upper bound, attained at the positive real point, and its equality condition yields uniqueness. The global norm is the monotone boundary limit; no finite sampling establishes the supremum.
scientific_limitations: The theorem exactly evaluates the harmonic Schwarzian norm of the explicit non-injective witness family used in the cited harmonic-inner-radius upper-bound argument. It does not prove the conjectured lower bound sigma_H(D)>=3/2, does not classify global extremal harmonic mappings, and the unique boundary-concentration statement is asserted only for alpha>1.
title: Exact radial Schwarzian profile of the Lehtinen witness family
